title: Count Words in a String
description: Given a string containing words separated by whitespace, count the total number of words in the string.
input: A string containing one or more words separated by spaces or other whitespace characters.
output: The total number of words present in the string.

examples.explanation: The string contains three words: Java, is, and easy.
The string contains three words: I, love, and Java.
The string contains only one word.
Multiple spaces between words do not create additional words.

constraints: Leading and trailing whitespace should not be counted as words.

approaches.name: Using String Split
approaches.description: Split the string using a whitespace pattern and count the resulting words.
approaches.whenToUse: Use when built-in String methods are allowed and the input consists of words separated by whitespace.

interviewTips: Know how the split() method works with regular expressions.
Be prepared to explain the time and space complexity.
